candidates.description: This vector represents Spanish noun-forming nominal suffixes, particularly those related to abstract concepts, actions, or states ending in variations of "-ción", "-sión", "-dad", and their plural forms.
This vector is related to adjectives and adverbs expressing magnitude, importance, variety, or specificity.
This vector activates common Spanish word roots and suffixes involving the letter 'c' or 'f'.
This vector activates on common Spanish nouns denoting abstract concepts, manners, or general spatial-temporal instances.
This feature vector activates on Spanish nominalizing suffixes and noun forms derived from verbs and adjectives.
This feature vector represents the concept of tourism and travel-related economic activity.
This vector represents active Spanish verbs and their inflectional morphemes denoting completion, action, or utilization.
This vector activates on tokens containing the substring "soc" (or its case variants) related to social concepts and terminology.
This vector represents spatial and temporal prepositions across multiple languages.
This vector activates on Spanish-language roots, prefixes, and biological or environmental terms.
